lsg.verification: Exact released OSIS Git blob verified during source preparation; offsets derived from pinned chapter projection.

french_tuple: [verse number, 1-based token ordinal, 0-based Unicode code-point start, exclusive end] in verse reading text without notes/markup, trimmed. Apostrophes and internal hyphens retained.

relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 32 verses reviewed against both pinned texts; all names and repeated occurrences kept distinct.
notes: Gen 10:2,6,22: supplied copula in French belongs to the genealogy formula, not to the first proper name.
Gen 10:10: Hebrew nominal kingdom construction becomes the French verb régna; both governing source units retained, possessive suffix contextual.
Gen 10:11–12: name forms and the two components of Rehoboth Hir preserved exactly, without harmonizing other editions.
Gen 10:19: directional suffixes and idiomatic geographic boundary expressions retained; no place identity inferred beyond the source text.
Gen 10:21: the possible syntactic ambiguity of the elder brother is not resolved by the alignment; link the epithet to the actual LSG phrase.
Gen 10:25: Peleg and the separate verb for division remain distinct despite the name wordplay.
Gen 10:30: nominal dwelling construction becomes French habitèrent; the underlying possessive is contextual.
Gen 10:32: one original verb has a discontinuous French expansion; both expressions retain the same MACULA occurrence.
editorial_review.limitations: Same editor performed both passes; no certified dictionary sense; no automated tests. Publication checks remain separate.
